import React from "react" import Header from "../Header" import "./index.css" const productsList = [ { id: 1, name: "Men's Casual Shirt", price: 799, image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1596755094514-f87e34085b2c?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80", description: "Comfortable everyday wear", }, { id: 2, name: "Women's Handbag", price: 1299, image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1584917865442-de89df76afd3?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80", description: "A stylish bag for every day", }, { id: 3, name: "Running Shoes", price: 1899, image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1542291026-7eec264c27ff?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80", description: "Lightweight and comfortable", }, { id: 4, name: "Classic Wrist Watch", price: 2499, image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1524805444758-089113d48a6d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80", description: "A simple, timeless design", }, { id: 5, name: "Wireless Headphones", price: 1599, image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1505740420928-5e560c06d30e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80", description: "Enjoy your favourite music", }, { id: 6, name: "Sunglasses", price: 599, image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511499767150-a48a237f0083?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80", description: "A smart look for sunny days", }, ] const Products = ({addToCart, cartCount}) => (

Our Products

Find something you will love.
